description: Creates a collection of the user's Snip.link links, or changes one (pass collection, its id from list_collections): its name, the line under it, its links in order, and whether it has a public page at snip.link/c/<address> that shows one button per live link, link-in-bio style. links replaces the collection's links in that order; leave it out to keep them. Free on every plan; the links themselves never change. Needs the user signed in to Snip.link.

collection.description: The id of the collection to change. Leave it out to create one.

description.description: One line under the name on the page. null removes it.

links.description: The links in order, each by short URL, ending or id (see list_links). Replaces the collection's links.

name.description: The collection's name, shown on its page.

public.description: true switches the public page on, false off. Off by default.

slug.description: The page's address after /c/: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Left out, one is made from the name.

name: save_collection
title: Create or change a collection
